comparisons.scene: A veteran player, playing their final match before retirement, gets substituted off. The entire stadium, including opposing fans, gives a standing ovation.
comparisons.ground_truth: The curtain falls on an immortal. A standing ovation that transcends tribal loyalty. They applaud the man, the myth, the decades of devotion written in the lines of his face. The game stands still to say goodbye.

baseline.text: The player is walking off the pitch. He is waving to the fans. The fans are standing up and clapping for him.

finetuned.text: The curtain falls on an immortal! A standing ovation that transcends tribal loyalty! He walks off the field, a titan of the game, tears of emotion in his eyes, as the entire stadium rises to pay homage to greatness!
